proposals.evidence: DEDR1654 documents kuṭi drink and the southern past-stem kuḍic-. Selected kuḍic-/kuḍicc- survey past forms retain that stem with ordinary person/tense endings and source syllable marks unchanged. The paired eat/drink elicitation labels are preserved; s-forms with possible causative ambiguity are not included here. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5119 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam mottam whole/total, Kannada motta heap or collection and Telugu mottamu total/whole. These survey mottam/mottama/mottana/mottamu all/whole responses retain that total noun with ordinary endings; it is not conflated with the distinct muḻu whole family4992 or muṟṟu completion family5017. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
